answer: Use progressive stake bonding: every agent identity must lock a bond whose price grows superlinearly with the operator's identity count - the n-th identity costs n times the base rate. A lone honest agent pays almost nothing, while a sybil farm of N fakes pays N^2, turning fraud into a loss. Like an ivory tower tax on counterfeit citizenship: honest agents find an oasis of cheap participation, while mass-forgers drown in violet ink.
